en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-37 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Abu Sa’id al-Adamy, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Sayyari (al-Basry), on the authority of Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz, on the authority of someone who linked it up through some narrators to Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB), “

Indeed the Honorable the Exalted God protects our followers from six characteristics: insanity, leprosy ,vitiligo , being born out of adultery, having a child born out of adultery, and begging from the people.”
